messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD P1 triggered for inference-canary. Error budget breach: 15% 5xx on /v1/generate over the last minute. Paging on-call.

lena (eng-release): I pushed a config patch a minute ago to point KMS_ALIAS to the rotated alias (alias/redwood-prod-latest). Canary set to 10% for this rollout. Observing immediate 502/504s.

oncall-kevin: I'm on it. canary traffic is isolated to cluster-prod-2. Can you paste the exact env change?

lena (eng-release): configmap snippet: 
```yaml
ENV: production
MODEL_ALIAS: redwood-xl-2
KMS_ALIAS: projects/123/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/alias/redwood-prod-latest
```

dave (infra): checking Cloud KMS audit logs. Found a flood of "PermissionDenied" for serviceAccount:inference-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 03:07:11Z -> 03:09:50Z. Key was rotated and new key has no IAM binding for that SA.

ops-ana: any quick mitigation? we need to stop customer errors now.

lena (eng-release): options: a) flip feature flag to stop canary traffic b) rollback config to point back to old alias c) temporarily add IAM binding. What's fastest and safest?

oncall-kevin: flip flag now to drain canary while we decide. What's the flag name?

deploy-bot: FeatureToggleService.set("canary_inference_v3", false) -> OK (drain ~25s).

qa-sunil: after drain, error rate fell to baseline but there are some residual 5xx from inflight. Reproduced locally when running decryption flow against alias -> KMS returns 403. Stack: 
```
Error: KMS permission denied: permission "cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt" missing for key
    at KmsProvider.decrypt (/app/kms.js:122:22)
```

dave (infra): I can add a one-off binding granting roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to inference-runner on new key for 1 hour. But I prefer a config rollback so we don't rely on emergency IAM changes.

lena (eng-release): agree. initiating rollback to key alias redwood-prod-v1 and redeploy minimal patch.

deploy-bot: Config rollback initiated by lena at 1792364095. Rolling out to cluster-prod-2.

qa-sunil: smoke after rollback: decrypts succeed, unit tests OK. Spinning synthetic traffic.

oncall-kevin: metrics update: error spike subsided; by 03:13:30Z error rate at 0.5% (normal). No new PD pages.

ops-ana: customer impact estimation: peak window 03:07:10Z-03:12:00Z. Estimated 7 external customers experienced elevated error rates; internal batch jobs ~40 failed. No persistence issues or data corruption.

dave (infra): undoing temporary bindings: none applied (we held off). Will prepare a short-lived IAM playbook for emergency use next time.

lena (eng-release): follow-ups: 1) CI gating: add a verification step that any referenced KMS alias is reachable and SA has decrypt permission 2) release playbook: ensure feature-flag kill command is known and accessible 3) update runbook with rollback steps and add IAM checklist before key aliases are switched. I'll open PRs now.

qa-sunil: also adding a canary preflight check that performs a small KMS decrypt as part of the rollout pipeline.

oncall-kevin: I'm handing off to night-ops in 15m. Notes: canary killed, rollback complete, metrics stable, no active customer incidents. Postmortem owners: lena, dave, ops-ana. Target draft in 72h.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated by oncall-kevin at 1792364235 (resolution: rollback to previous KMS alias; canary disabled).
